summary: Iteration 119 - Maintenance Report Bug Fixes - ALL 13 tests PASSED. Fixed 2 bugs during testing: (1) Added missing 'recruiter_phone' field to CompleteNaukriProfileInput model, (2) Fixed UnboundLocalError for normalize_phone function by renaming local helper to _normalize_phone_for_compare. Verified: name validation rejects nav text, phone filtering strips recruiter's phone, evaluate-fit and stats endpoints work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CompleteNaukriProfileInput model was missing 'recruiter_phone' and 'recruiter_email' fields - added them
FIXED: Local normalize_phone function definitions inside if blocks were shadowing global function, causing UnboundLocalError - renamed to _normalize_phone_for_compare
Name validation correctly rejects nav text patterns: 'Search candidates', 'Resdex', 'Application Received', 'Showing X candidates', 'Filter by', 'Page X of Y', 'X profiles found'
Phone filtering correctly strips recruiter's own phone from candidate profile when they match
Stress mode hysteresis correctly implemented: ON < 40, OFF > 60, no change between 40-60
Data sync regex is tight and won't match 'email.send' - only matches sync_fail, data_drift, mismatch patterns
.doc file handling has 3 fallback methods for edge cases

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 119 tested and fixed maintenance report bugs. Key findings: (1) Name validation - 'Search candidates', 'Resdex', 'Application Received', 'Showing 25 candidates' all correctly rejected - PASS, (2) Valid name 'Priya Sharma' accepted - PASS, (3) Year suffix stripped from name 'Rajiv Mathur - 15 Year(s)' - PASS, (4) Recruiter phone filtering works - same phone stripped, different phone kept - PASS, (5) evaluate-fit endpoint returns verdict/criteria/summary - PASS, (6) stats endpoint works - PASS. Two bugs were found and fixed during testing: (a) Missing recruiter_phone field in CompleteNaukriProfileInput model, (b) UnboundLocalError for normalize_phone function due to local function shadowing global.

tests: name='Rajiv Mathur - 15 Year(s)' → year suffix stripped, accepted

missing_recruiter_phone_field.issue: CompleteNaukriProfileInput model was missing 'recruiter_phone' field, causing AttributeError when capture endpoint tried to access profile.recruiter_phone
missing_recruiter_phone_field.fix: Added 'recruiter_phone: Optional[str] = None' and 'recruiter_email: Optional[str] = None' fields to CompleteNaukriProfileInput model

normalize_phone_unbound_error.issue: Local normalize_phone function was defined inside 'if recruiter_phone:' block, shadowing global function. When recruiter_phone was empty, the function was never defined, causing UnboundLocalError at line 1408
normalize_phone_unbound_error.fix: Renamed local function to '_normalize_phone_for_compare' and moved it outside the if block

health_monitor_data_sync_regex.note: This regex will NOT match 'email.send' - it requires specific patterns like 'sync' followed by 'fail'

stress_mode_hysteresis.note: Prevents oscillation when score hovers around 50

doc_file_handling.note: Returns empty string if all methods fail, preventing 422 errors
